profile.reading: Per QTS own site, this Chicago facility is located at 2800 S Ashland Ave, Chicago, IL 60608 on a 30 acre campus near downtown Chicago, planned as a two-building facility at full build-out (second building in pre-leasing). LEED Gold and Energy Star certified; closed-loop water-recirculating cooling. No square footage or MW capacity figures are published.
